sections.name: File setup
sections.title: List of required settings
sections.what: Lists each setting name with a short comment. It covers the AI key and models, the Redis link and token, the login signing secret, and a one-time admin setup secret.
sections.why: Likely reason: documents what the owner must provide before the app will run.
sections.watch_out: The setup secret should be removed after the one-time admin setup, as the comment says.

summary: Template that lists the settings the app needs, such as AI keys, the Redis database link and the login signing secret, with placeholder values.
purpose: Shows the owner which secret values to set up before running the app.
why: Likely reason: keeps real secrets out of the code while still showing which ones are needed.
how: 1. Copy this file to a local settings file that is kept out of version control. 2. Replace each placeholder with a real value. 3. The app reads these names when it starts.
inputs: The owner's real keys and settings, entered by hand.
outputs: Nothing by itself. It supplies the names and examples for the real settings file.
risks: The comment above the main model says Kimi K2 is recommended, but the value set is DeepSeek V4 Pro. Trust the value and confirm the choice. Placeholder secrets must be replaced, or login is unsafe. The setup comment names a specific person, which is fine as a note but should be removed once setup is done.
debug: If a feature reports a missing key, check that the name matches the real settings. If login fails, check SESSION_SECRET and the Redis URL and token.
